bounded_host_request.command: docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -U gace -d gaybbs -At -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c "SELECT 'ROOMS='||count(*) FROM room_posts WHERE request_key='room:'||(SELECT owner_user_id::text FROM public_post_drafts WHERE module='room' AND revision=141 LIMIT 1)||':141'; SELECT 'DRAFTS='||count(*) FROM public_post_drafts WHERE module='room' AND revision=141 AND step='preview'; SELECT 'LINKED_ANNOUNCEMENTS='||count(*) FROM announcement_posts a JOIN room_posts r ON a.room_id=r.room_id WHERE r.request_key LIKE 'room:%:141'; SELECT 'DELIVERIES='||count(*) FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text AND d.source_type='announcement' JOIN room_posts r ON a.room_id=r.room_id WHERE r.request_key LIKE 'room:%:141'; SELECT 'DELIVERY_STATES='||coalesce(string_agg(d.status||':'||CASE WHEN d.telegram_message_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'has_message' ELSE 'no_message' END,','),'none') FROM posting_deliveries d JOIN announcement_posts a ON d.source_id=a.announcement_id::text AND d.source_type='announcement' JOIN room_posts r ON a.room_id=r.room_id WHERE r.request_key LIKE 'room:%:141';"
